body: Thanks! Taken into 0.1.39. The engine flag stays default-off, and setup now adds --remote-expert-opt to a config on two or more GPUs. To leave it out, pass setup --no-remote-expert-opt or set "remote_expert_opt": false in the config. It acts only with a helper cache (--expert-cache-device1..3), so a layer split runs as before. We have one GPU here: we checked the build, the refusal without --serve and byte-identical default output. Merged with #646, which publishes the routing weights only when a helper needs them, so with the flag the doorbell still sends them. The dual-GPU numbers are yours (dual RTX 4090 +63% mixed / +132% code over the plain helper path).
